nl.title: Hoe gebruik ik de DNS Zone Editor in DirectAdmin?
nl.excerpt: Bewerk A, AAAA, CNAME, MX en TXT in de DirectAdmin DNS Zone Editor.
nl.bodyHtml:
DNS Zone Editor wijzigt records op TripleZero iT-nameservers. Één wijziging tegelijk, oude waarde noteren.

Voorbereiding

  • Domein op DA-DNS
  • Welk record

Stappen

  1. DNS Management → zone van het domein
  2. Edit/Add record
  3. TTL bewust zetten
  4. Sla op
  5. Verifieer met dig/nslookup

Controleren

  • Nieuw record zichtbaar extern na TTL

Tip: Externe DNS (Cloudflare): wijzig daar, niet in DA.

Let op: CNAME op apex (@) is meestal ongeldig.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: domain-forward; google-verify.

en.title: How do I use the DNS Zone Editor in DirectAdmin?
en.excerpt: How do I use the DNS Zone Editor in DirectAdmin: steps in DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor) for DNS, zone, editor.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers How do I use the DNS Zone Editor in DirectAdmin. You work in DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor), focusing on DNS, zone, editor — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor)
  • Focus of this article: DNS, zone, editor
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor) and look specifically for settings around DNS, zone, editor.
  2. Open DNS management for the correct domain; export/screenshot the zone.
  3. Change only records that belong to DNS / zone (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS).
  4. Save; wait for TTL/propagation.
  5. Verify with an external lookup; then test site or mail.
  6. Document what you changed around DNS, zone, editor (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for DNS, zone, editor matches “How do I use the DNS Zone Editor in DirectAdmin”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside DNS zone editor
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get DNS, zone, editor right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if DNS, zone, editor touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor), backups, tickets.
